item.title: Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe
item.description:
📝 Traders Union All News Central Banks Deutsche Bank will clear yuan transactions All news Top Stories Editors' Picks Stocks Crypto Economics Currencies Commodities Business & Wealth Market Voices Olga Shendetskaya Yesterday Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe Deutsche Bank gains European yuan clearing role China has authorized Deutsche Bank to clear renminbi transactions in Europe, giving a foreign lender a role previously handled in the region by Chinese banks. Highlights Deutsche Bank will clear renminbi transactions from Frankfurt. The designation followed a memorandum of understanding between Deutsche Bank and the People’s Bank of China.
